film.title: A Few Quiet Moments
film.description: A short sample film in three scenes. A gold sun rises over the hills, warm lights glow across a lakeshore, and a violet sky gives way to stars.

letter.title: For all the days still to come
paragraphs: A museum makes room for the things we want to keep. If I could leave one more thing here, it would be an ordinary day with you. The kind we would never think to take a picture of.
I hope the rooms keep filling up.

additionalFilms.title: Lakeside Lights
additionalFilms.description: An excerpt from A Few Quiet Moments. Warm lights begin to glow across a quiet lakeshore.

additionalFilms.title: A Sky Full of Stars
additionalFilms.description: An excerpt from A Few Quiet Moments. The last light fades into a violet sky full of stars.
